order_rules: features: feature-order.tsv (goal first); stories: same-feature prerequisites first (dependency or conflict), then priority, unblock count, complexity, size, number; open questions never affect order
question_rule: an open question is answered inside the work (recommended answer, or the story owner decides at the start); nothing waits on an answer
concurrency_rules: stories in one lane run in sequence (dependency, planned order or one shared scope); different lanes run in parallel; same-file collisions are not checked
